articles.title: US and Iran hold first talks since June after Trump's 'annihilation' threat
articles.description: The talks are the first since a ceasefire collapsed in June, with the sides exchanging fire intermittently.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏の「殲滅」脅威後、米国とイランが6月以来初の会談を実施
articles.summary: 停戦崩壊後、米国とイランが対話を開始。両国は断続的に交戦しており、今後の関係に注目が集まる。

articles.title: Reports of violence against women in Gaza surge, UN agency finds
articles.description: The UN Population Fund also says there has been a "severe escalation" in the number of early and forced marriages.
articles.titleJa: ガザ地区で女性への暴力が急増、国連機関が報告
articles.summary: 国連人口基金によると、ガザ地区で女性への暴力が激増。早婚や強制結婚も深刻化しており、人道状況の悪化が懸念される。

articles.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
articles.description: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.
articles.titleJa: エチオピアとティグレが互いに攻勢を非難、新たな戦争の懸念が高まる
articles.summary: エチオピア政府とティグレ勢力が互いに攻撃を開始したと主張。ドローン攻撃後に空港が占拠され、新内戦への緊張が高まっている。

articles.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
articles.description: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.
articles.titleJa: 87歳女性の劇的な立ち退きがスペインの住宅不足を浮き彫りに
articles.summary: マドリードで87歳の女性が家賃を払えず立ち退きを強いられた事例が、スペインの深刻な住宅問題に光を当てている。

articles.title: Dolly Parton's manager accuses her nephew of 'threats and intimidation'
articles.description: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton's death to the world, is accused of trying to extort her estate.

articles.title: Trump administration accuses banned media outlets of 'falsehoods' ahead of court hearing
articles.description: The US Justice Department's response to a lawsuit filed by CNN, Politico and MS NOW also cites national security.
articles.titleJa: トランプ政権、法廷審問を前に禁止されたメディアを「虚偽」と非難
articles.summary: 米司法省がCNNなどメディアの訴訟に対し、国家安全保障を理由に「虚偽」と反論。トランプ政権とメディアの対立が激化している。

articles.title: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
articles.description: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカで家屋での銃乱射事件により11人死亡
articles.summary: 南アフリカで発生した銃乱射事件で11人が死亡。犠牲者の中には妊婦も含まれており、警察が捜査を進めている。

articles.title: South Sudan's president dissolves government ahead of country's first elections
articles.description: South Sudan has not held elections since independence in 2011 - polls have twice been postponed.
articles.titleJa: 南スーダン大統領、初の総選挙を前に政府を解散
articles.summary: 2011年の独立以来初の総選挙を控える南スーダンで、大統領が政府を解散した。選挙は過去2回延期されている。

articles.title: More than 170,000 respiratory cases recorded in haze-choked Indonesia
articles.description: More than 40,000 of the cases – which range from mild coughs to pneumonia – involve toddlers.
articles.titleJa: 煙霧に覆われたインドネシアで呼吸器疾患が17万人以上発生
articles.summary: 煙霧に悩まされるインドネシアで、17万人以上が呼吸器疾患を患い、そのうち4万人以上が幼児。深刻な公衆衛生問題となっている。

articles.title: Hurricane Polo downgraded but remains 'very powerful' off coast of Mexico
articles.description: The large storm in the Pacific Ocean is being driven by warm waters caused by the El Niño weather phenomenon.
articles.titleJa: ハリケーン・ポロが勢力減退もメキシコ沖で「依然非常に強力」
articles.summary: ハリケーン・ポロは勢力を弱めたものの、エルニーニョ現象による暖かい海水によりメキシコ沖で依然として非常に強力なままだ。

articles.title: China's 13-year-old swimming star raises questions on child athletes
articles.description: Three gold medals and three Asian Games records have catapulted China's Yu Zidi, 13, into the sporting spotlight. She is far from the first teen prodigy, but should teens be competing at elite level?
articles.titleJa: 中国の13歳水泳スター、児童選手に関する疑問を提起
articles.summary: 中国の13歳の水泳選手、Yu Zidiが3つの金メダルを獲得し注目を集めている。この記事では、ティーンエージャーがエリートレベルで競技すべきかという児童選手に関する問題を提起している。

articles.title: Pakistan's jailed former PM Khan's sons told DW the authorities are cracking down ahead of new PTI protests
articles.description: The sons of jailed Pakistani ex-PM Imran Khan told DW their father is in ill-health while being isolated from family and doctors. Other family members have been detained ahead of a planned opposition protest.
articles.titleJa: パキスタン、拘束されたカーン元首相の息子たちが、PTIの新たな抗議活動を前に当局が取り締まりを強化しているとDWに語る
articles.summary: パキスタンの拘束されたイムラン・カーン元首相の息子たちは、父親が体調を崩し隔離されているとDWに語った。PTIの抗議活動を前に他の家族も拘束されており、当局の弾圧が報じられている。

articles.title: Slovakia: PM Robert Fico's NATO Article 5 remarks spark criticism and raise questions about his country's NATO commitment
articles.description: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico says he fears war and will do everything he can to keep his country out of one. Critics say his remarks risk weakening NATO, the alliance that was designed to prevent such a war.
articles.titleJa: スロバキア：フィツォ首相のNATO第5条に関する発言が批判を呼び、同国のNATOへのコミットメントに疑問を投げかける
articles.summary: スロバキアのロベルト・フィツォ首相は戦争を恐れ、国を戦争から遠ざけるために全力を尽くすと発言。批評家は、この発言がNATOの結束を弱めるリスクがあると指摘している。

articles.title: Germany's oldest party, the center-left SPD, is in a difficult position following its success in the Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania state election
articles.description: Chancellor Friedrich Merz (CDU) has vowed to press ahead with controversial reforms, but resistance is mounting within his coalition partner, the SPD. How much dissent can a governing coalition tolerate?
articles.titleJa: ドイツ最古の政党である中道左派SPDは、メクレンブルク＝フォアポンメルン州選挙での成功後、困難な立場に置かれている
articles.summary: ドイツのSPDは、州選挙での成功にもかかわらず、連立政権内の抵抗に直面し困難な状況にある。首相が物議を醸す改革を推進する中、連立内での意見の不一致がどこまで許容されるかが問われている。

articles.title: Ethiopia: Fighting resumes in Tigray
articles.description: Rebels in northern Ethiopia have seized regional airports and engaged government troops in Afar and Amhara. Observers fear deadly clashes could expand after rebels announced a new anti-government alliance.
articles.titleJa: エチオピア：ティグレで戦闘が再開
articles.summary: エチオピア北部ティグレ地方で戦闘が再開され、反政府勢力が地域空港を占拠し、アファル州やアムハラ州で政府軍と交戦。新たな反政府同盟の発表後、衝突拡大の懸念が高まっている。

articles.title: ICC convicts CAR ex-rebel leader of crimes against humanity
articles.description: The International Criminal Court has found Mahamat Said Abdel Kani guilty of overseeing torture and other crimes. He headed a feared prison unit that held political prisoners.
articles.titleJa: ICC、中央アフリカ共和国の元反政府勢力指導者を人道に対する罪で有罪と認定
articles.summary: 国際刑事裁判所は、中央アフリカ共和国の元反政府勢力指導者マハマト・サイド・アブデル・カニに対し、拷問やその他の人道に対する罪で有罪判決を下した。彼は政治犯を収容する恐ろしい刑務所を率いていた。

articles.title: As the EU advances free trade with Southeast Asia, why is there no ASEAN-wide deal?
articles.description: After years of arduous negotiations, the EU is closing on a string of bilateral trade deals with countries in Southeast Asia. And yet, a bloc-to-bloc agreement between the EU and ASEAN remains a distant prospect.
articles.titleJa: EUが東南アジアとの自由貿易を進める中、なぜASEAN全体の協定がないのか？
articles.summary: EUは長年の交渉を経て東南アジア諸国との二国間貿易協定を進めているが、EUとASEAN間の地域全体の協定は依然として遠い見通しである。貿易交渉の現状と課題を解説。

articles.title: Munich, Berlin, Cologne-Rhine-Ruhr – Germany's three Olympic candidates
articles.description: Munich, Berlin, or the Cologne-Rhine-Ruhr region? Germany aims to host the Olympic Games again. Three candidates are in the running, with one city considered the slight favorite.
articles.titleJa: ミュンヘン、ベルリン、ケルン＝ライン＝ルール – ドイツの3つのオリンピック候補地
articles.summary: ドイツは再びオリンピック開催を目指しており、ミュンヘン、ベルリン、ケルン＝ライン＝ルール地域の3都市が候補に挙がっている。いずれかの都市が開催地となるか注目される。

articles.title: Rome's Colosseum closes after worker falls to his death
articles.description: The man had been working on a new lighting installation in the iconic Roman amphitheater. Italian authorities said they were working on determining the circumstances of the accident.
articles.titleJa: ローマのコロッセオ、作業員の転落死亡事故により閉鎖
articles.summary: ローマの象徴的な円形闘技場コロッセオで、新しい照明設備の作業中に男性作業員が転落死した。イタリア当局は事故の状況を調査中で、この事件によりコロッセオは閉鎖されている。

articles.title: Hungary: EU Commission wants to unblock €4.2b in funding
articles.description: The Commission's president has argued that Budapest is strengthening the rule of law with Viktor Orban finally out of office. Funds had been blocked over corruption allegations under Hungary's former government.
articles.titleJa: ハンガリー：EU委員会、42億ユーロの資金凍結解除を検討
articles.summary: EU委員会は、ハンガリーのヴィクトル・オルバン氏が失脚し法の支配が強化されていると主張し、42億ユーロの資金凍結解除を検討。以前は汚職疑惑で資金が保留されていた。

articles.title: Indian billionaire’s payments firm plots biggest London flotation in years
articles.description:
Sunil Bharti Mittal’s Airtel Money targets $9bn IPO in boost for ailing UK stock market
A payments business that operates across Africa and is ultimately controlled by an Indian billionaire has announced its intention to float on the struggling London Stock Exchange.
Airtel Money, the mobile money arm of Airtel Africa, is planning one of the biggest UK listings in years, in a boost for the shrinking London market that has faced a string of recent departures.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: インドの大富豪の決済企業、ロンドンで数年ぶりの大型上場を計画
articles.summary: インドの大富豪が所有しアフリカで事業展開する決済企業が、ロンドン証券取引所で90億ドルのIPOを計画している。これはロンドン市場にとって大きな後押しとなる。

articles.title: Top South African police officer charged with raping woman, 18, and grooming 16-year-old girl
articles.description:
Arrest of Shadrack Sibiya comes as country reels from cases of femicide and alleged police corruption and criminality
One of South Africa’s most senior police officers has been charged with raping an 18-year-old woman and grooming a 16-year-old girl, as the country’s police face allegations of corruption and failing to tackle violence against women and girls.
Shadrack Sibiya, who was already suspended from his role as deputy national police commissioner over allegations he interfered with political killings investigations, was arrested on Monday. He is facing charges of rape, people trafficking, promoting the sexual grooming of a child and two counts of grooming a child.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカの警察幹部、18歳女性へのレイプと16歳少女へのグルーミングで起訴
articles.summary: 南アフリカの警察幹部が、18歳女性へのレイプと16歳少女へのグルーミングの罪で起訴された。この逮捕は、女性に対する暴力や警察の汚職が問題視される中で行われた。

articles.title: Healthcare in Africa ‘under growing strain’ after US withdrawal from aid programs, report warns
articles.description:
Accra Reset’s report states countries in the region and global south should take greater control of their health development after USAID debacle
The United States’ withdrawal from key aid programs has put healthcare in Africa and the Global South “under growing strain” a new report warns.
The report says the Trump administration’s cuts to programs such as US Agency for International Development (USAID), as well as the Covid-19 pandemic and rising costs of living globally have brought “new urgency” for the need to reform healthcare in the region.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国の援助プログラム撤退後、アフリカの医療が「増大する負担」に直面と報告書が警告
articles.summary: 報告書によると、米国が主要な援助プログラムから撤退したことで、アフリカとグローバルサウスの医療システムに大きな負担がかかっている。改革の緊急性が増している。

articles.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
articles.description:
After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millions
No one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane where they were going. The officers in charge would taunt them when they asked, they said. It was only when the seat-back video screens finally showed a map that the 18 migrants worked it out.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 異国の地へ追放：トランプの秘密の強制送還協定
articles.summary: トランプ政権が数カ国と結んだ秘密協定により、数千人が米国から強制送還された。イラン人女性はアフリカの知らない国へ送られた事例も報告されている。

articles.title: Men deported from US bound and beaten in Equatorial Guinea detention hotel, lawyers say
articles.description:
Group trapped at Hotel Bamy after US removal as rights groups sound alarm over poor conditions and violence

Two men that the Trump administration expelled to Equatorial Guinea were bound, fitted with bags over their heads, beaten and pushed down a flight of stairs, all in plain view of other US deportees, according to witnesses and human rights lawyers.
The men – one from Egypt and one from Eritrea – were then taken to a prison. About 30 detainees from the US remain trapped at a hotel in the outskirts of the coastal city of Malabo after being deported from the US. Detainees have said they believe the men were beaten for telling the press and human rights advocates about the poor conditions and violence inside the hotel, and that they are haunted by flashbacks and terrified they will be retaliated against next.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国から強制送還された男性たち、赤道ギニアの拘束施設で縛られ暴行を受けたと弁護士が証言
articles.summary: 米国から赤道ギニアへ強制送還された男性らが、拘束施設で暴行を受けたと弁護士が報告。約30人がホテルに閉じ込められ、劣悪な状況に置かれているという。

articles.title: Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby
articles.description:
Venezuela’s interim president hails ‘historic meeting’ and does not say whether she will visit snatched predecessor
Venezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, has celebrated a “historic” meeting with Donald Trump in New York, posing for a smiley photo with the US president, less than nine months after he ordered the abduction of her boss, Nicolás Maduro.
The former foes met at a five-star hotel a few blocks from Trump Tower in Manhattan late on Tuesday on the sidelines of the UN general assembly. The hotel is about 7 miles from the Brooklyn prison where Maduro has been held since he was snatched during a special forces raid on Caracas in January.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: デルシー・ロドリゲス、ニューヨークでトランプとポーズ、一方マドゥロは近くの刑務所で苦境
articles.summary: ベネズエラの暫定大統領デルシー・ロドリゲスがニューヨークでトランプ大統領と「歴史的会談」をしたと発表。これは、マドゥロが同市内の刑務所に収監されている中で行われた。

articles.title: Jamaica hails King’s decision to refer slavery reparations petition to privy council as ‘really big deal’
articles.description:
The move comes after Jamaica’s culture minister Olivia Grange travelled to the UK earlier this month to lodge the historic petition
King Charles has referred a landmark slavery reparations petition from Jamaica to a high-level UK appeals court for legal advice, Jamaica’s culture minister announced in parliament on Tuesday.
Referring to the move as a “really big deal”, Olivia Grange told Jamaica’s MPs the monarch had confirmed that their legal questions have been passed on to the London-based privy council – the final court of appeal for UK overseas territories and some Commonwealth countries.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ジャマイカ、奴隷制賠償請願を枢密院に付託する国王の決定を「本当に大きなこと」と称賛
articles.summary: チャールズ国王が、ジャマイカからの奴隷制賠償請願を英国の高等上訴裁判所である枢密院に付託した。ジャマイカ文化大臣はこれを「非常に大きな進展」と評価した。

articles.title: Hurricane Polo, rapidly intensifying from strong El Niño patterns, rages off coast of Mexico
articles.description:
Polo, with sustained winds of 165mph, is churning 215 miles south of Zihuatanejo but is unlikely to directly hit Mexico
A tropical storm off the south-west coast of Mexico has intensified into a category 5 monster in fewer than 24 hours, fueled by stronger than usual El Niño weather patterns in the Pacific Ocean.
Hurricane Polo was sending out maximum sustained winds of 165mph (266km/h) on Tuesday as its center churned about 215 miles (346km) south of the coastal city of Zihuatanejo, in Guerrero state.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 強いエルニーニョパターンで急速に勢力を増すハリケーン・ポロ、メキシコ沖で猛威
articles.summary: 強いエルニーニョ現象の影響で、メキシコ南西沖の熱帯低気圧が急速にカテゴリー5のハリケーン「ポロ」に発達。メキシコへの直接上陸はなさそうだ。

articles.title: Trump’s threat to annihilate Iran to UN general assembly is stunning, even for him
articles.description:
US president may have upstaged the ghost of Soviet leader Khrushchev by musing destruction of fellow member state
Donald Trump has a habit of discomfiting delegates to the United Nations general assembly. But this year, he may have upstaged the ghost of Nikita Khrushchev by openly contemplating the annihilation of a fellow UN member state.
Eleven minutes into a 40-minute address, the US president announced he had “a big decision to make” over Iran, which has staged a much more determined resistance than Trump anticipated when he decided to go to war against the country in February.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプの国連総会でのイラン「壊滅」発言、彼にしては驚くべきもの
articles.summary: トランプ大統領が国連総会でイランの「壊滅」を公然と示唆。この発言は、彼にしては異例の強硬さで、国際社会に衝撃を与えている。

articles.title: British Columbia sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over Tumbler Ridge mass school shooting
articles.description:
Canadian province alleges deadly attack could have been prevented if  company had warned police of shooter’s ChatGPT use
British Columbia has sued OpenAI, saying a mass shooting at a school in the Canadian province could have been prevented if the company had warned local ⁠law enforcement that the shooter ⁠had used ChatGPT to ​plan the attack.
The lawsuit, filed in San Francisco federal court on Monday, names OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, as defendants. It is seeking damages to fund recovery efforts in the province after the February attack, as well as an order directing changes to the way the company handles ChatGPT conversations that could lead to violence.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ブリティッシュコロンビア州、タンブラーリッジ銃乱射事件でOpenAIとサム・アルトマンを提訴
articles.summary: カナダのブリティッシュコロンビア州が、ChatGPTが銃乱射事件の計画に使われたことについてOpenAIを提訴。同社が警察に警告しなかったため事件を防げなかったと主張している。

articles.title: Trump’s Russia tariffs could threaten to deepen Europe’s LNG squeeze
articles.description: The European Commission has said it will work with Washington to make sure that as little disruption as possible will come from the latest tariffs against Russian energy announced by Donald Trump.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏のロシア関税、欧州のLNG逼迫を深刻化させる恐れ
articles.summary: トランプ氏が発表したロシア産エネルギーに対する関税により、欧州のLNG供給が逼迫する可能性があり、欧州委員会は混乱を最小限に抑えるためワシントンと協力すると表明しました。

articles.title: From Classical to Mugham: Montreux hosts Azerbaijan’s musical heritage
articles.description: From centuries-old mugham to opera, jazz and traditional dance, Azerbaijan takes centre stage as the Montreux-Vevey festival celebrates its 80th anniversary.
articles.titleJa: クラシックからムガムまで：モントルーでアゼルバイジャンの音楽遺産を紹介
articles.summary: モントルー・ヴヴェイ音楽祭80周年を記念し、アゼルバイジャンのムガム、オペラ、ジャズ、伝統舞踊といった豊かな音楽遺産が披露され、注目を集めています。

articles.title: 'Largest global fuel supply disruption in history': Which Europeans are paying the most for fuel?
articles.description: The global oil crisis sent petrol and diesel peaking over €2.4/L and €2.5/L, but figures adjusted for the cost of living give a better indication of which countries are feeling the pinch the worst.
articles.titleJa: 「史上最大の世界的燃料供給混乱」：燃料価格が最も高いのはどのヨーロッパ諸国か？
articles.summary: 世界的な石油危機によりガソリンとディーゼル価格が高騰しており、生活費で調整されたデータが、どの欧州諸国が最も深刻な影響を受けているかを示しています。

articles.title: Project Sunrise update: Qantas to launch non-stop flights between Sydney and New York from 2028
articles.description: Passengers will spend 18 hours in the air on the specially configured Airbus A350-1000ULR aircraft.
articles.titleJa: プロジェクト・サンライズ最新情報：カンタス航空、2028年からシドニーとニューヨーク間の直行便を就航
articles.summary: カンタス航空は、2028年からシドニーとニューヨークを結ぶ直行便「プロジェクト・サンライズ」を開始すると発表しました。特別仕様のエアバス機で18時間のフライトとなります。

articles.title: OECD lifts 2026 global economic growth forecast to 2.9% despite Iran war disruption
articles.description: The OECD has nudged up its forecast for global growth this year to 2.9%, saying the world economy has absorbed the energy shock from the Iran war better than expected, but it warned that persistent inflation, rising bond yields and the risk of a longer conflict continue to cloud the outlook.
articles.titleJa: OECD、イラン戦争の混乱にもかかわらず2026年の世界経済成長予測を2.9%に引き上げ
articles.summary: OECDは、イラン戦争によるエネルギーショックを世界経済が想定以上に吸収したとし、今年のグローバル成長予測を2.9%に上方修正しましたが、リスクも警告しています。

articles.title: From Tian Shan peaks to Silk Road history: A journey through Turkistan

articles.title: World Trade Report: Trade reform to boost growth; inaction can cost 10% global GDP
articles.description: The 2026 edition of the World Trade Report – issued on 15 September - finds that a strengthened multilateral trading system could increase global GDP by roughly 3% or USD 3 trillion by 2050, while inaction to modernize the trading system could reduce global output by up to 10%. The flagship publication of the WTO Secretariat, examining what the multilateral trading system has delivered over 80 years and where it is facing challenges, offers evidence relevant to ongoing efforts to keep trade rules fit for purpose.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易報告書：貿易改革が成長を促進。無策は世界GDPの10%を失う可能性
articles.summary: 2026年世界貿易報告書は、貿易システムの強化が2050年までに世界GDPを3%増加させ、無策の場合は10%減少させる可能性があると指摘しています。

articles.title: World Trade & Tech Day: AI and trade increasingly intertwined
articles.description: Hundreds of participants gathered at the WTO for World Trade & Tech Day on 14 September, a sign of how AI is fundamentally changing the way cross-border commerce is evolving. Under the banner of "AI and Trade: Turning Potential into Progress", the day consisted of a full day of panel discussions and other knowledge-sharing opportunities aimed at fostering conversations on technology and trade. The event shone a spotlight on how AI and frontier technologies are making international trade more efficient, bringing together government leaders as well as academics and private sector representatives to discuss ways to harness AI's potential into tangible economic gains and an engine for inclusive growth.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易・テクノロジーデー：AIと貿易はますます密接に絡み合う
articles.summary: WTOで開催された世界貿易・テクノロジーデーでは、AIが国際貿易をいかに変革し、効率化するかについて議論され、その潜在的な経済的利益が強調されました。

articles.title: Russian Federation notifies launch of safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products
articles.description: On 9 September 2026, the Russian Federation notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 7 September 2026 of a safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products with polymer coating imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union.
articles.titleJa: ロシア連邦、特定フラット鋼製品のセーフガード調査開始を通知
articles.summary: ロシア連邦は、ユーラシア経済連合の税関領域に輸入される特定のポリマーコーティングされたフラット鋼製品に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知しました。

articles.title: WTO study explores the role of stablecoins in international trade
articles.description: The WTO Secretariat launched a new publication on the role of stablecoins in supporting cross-border trade on 14 September on the sidelines of the WTO's first World Trade and Tech Day. The report, prepared by the Economic Research and Statistics Division and the Trade in Services and Investment Division, examines the opportunities and challenges associated with the use of stablecoins in facilitating international trade, highlighting how they can accelerate cross-border payments and their potential to increase participation in the international trading system, especially for developing economies.
articles.titleJa: WTO、国際貿易におけるステーブルコインの役割を研究
articles.summary: WTO事務局は、国際貿易におけるステーブルコインの役割に関する新たな報告書を発表。国境を越えた決済の加速と途上国の参加拡大の可能性を探ります。

articles.title: Goods barometer points to resilient trade growth despite headwinds
articles.description: Global goods trade continued to strengthen in mid-2026 despite persistent geopolitical and policy-related uncertainties, according to the WTO Goods Trade Barometer released on 9 September 2026.
articles.titleJa: 物品貿易バロメーター、逆風にもかかわらず堅調な貿易成長を示す
articles.summary: WTO物品貿易バロメーターによると、2026年半ばも世界的な地政学的・政策的不確実性にもかかわらず、世界の物品貿易は引き続き堅調に推移しました。

articles.title: WTO issues 2026 Annual Report
articles.description: The WTO published today (9 September) its 2026 Annual Report, providing a comprehensive account of the organization’s activities in 2025 and the early part of 2026. The Report looks back at recent key events, such as the 14th Ministerial Conference in March 2026, and describes the WTO's work in addressing the challenges and opportunities facing world trade.
articles.titleJa: WTOが2026年年次報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは、2025年と2026年初頭の活動をまとめた2026年年次報告書を公表。世界の貿易が直面する課題と機会への取り組みを詳述しています。
